rhythm.instruction: Match Marie's distribution and variation; SD rhythm is comparison data, not a target.

sdConstructions.pattern: X is not Y. It is Z.
sdConstructions.reason: SD's most frequent construction (40+ instances in corpus); already a warn as not-X-but-Y.
sdConstructions.useInstead: State what it is without the negation setup.
Open on what changes this week.

sdConstructions.pattern: Let's dive into what the stars have in store
sdConstructions.useInstead: No transition; start the first block.

sdConstructions.pattern: Here is to a week of [noun], [noun], and [phrase]

sdConstructions.useInstead: Deliver the lesson as an observation about behavior.

sdConstructions.pattern: [ritual-prop reflex: light a candle and name what you release]
sdConstructions.useInstead: Only concrete actions that fit the surface.

sdConstructions.pattern: [nervous-system vocabulary: regulate, fight or flight, the real work starts in your nervous system]
sdConstructions.useInstead: Name the feeling and the behavior.

sdConstructions.pattern: the version of you who already has it

sdConstructions.reason: SD affirmational permission; distinct from Marie's falsifiable permission lines.
sdConstructions.useInstead: Permission must be specific and falsifiable: allowed to do a nameable thing.

sdConstructions.pattern: [portal / transmission / light codes / frequency / highest timeline / downloads]
sdConstructions.useInstead: Outside the editorial frame; do not use.

sdConstructions.pattern: the universe is [saying yes / giving you a green light]
sdConstructions.useInstead: Planets act; the universe does not speak.

sdConstructions.pattern: You just need to take the next inspired step
